About the author

Jeff Howe is the author, with Media Lab Director Joi Ito, of Whiplash: How to Survive Our Faster Future. A longtime contributing editor at Wired magazine, he coined the term crowdsourcing in a 2006 article for that magazine, and in 2008, he published a book with Random House that looked more deeply at the phenomenon of massive online collaboration. Called Crowdsourcing: How the Power of the Crowd is Driving the Future of Business, it has been translated into ten languages. Jeff is program coordinator for Media Innovation at Northeastern, and an assistant professor at Northeastern University.
